channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: UK PM Vows to Curb Non-Compete Clauses in Job Contracts
item.description: Prime Minister Burnham has pledged to restrict the use of non-compete clauses in employment contracts, stating that current limitations on what workers can do after leaving a role have "gone too far." He described the planned crackdown as… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Poilievre to campaign for Canadian unity in Alberta
item.description: Pierre Poilievre is scheduled to campaign for Canadian unity in Alberta next week, ahead of a referendum. He will deliver a speech on the topic. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Brussels Protest Sees Thousands March, Clashes Erupt
item.description: Thousands of workers and students protested in Brussels against the federal government's policies. The demonstration, described as an anti-austerity rally, turned violent with clashes erupting between protesters and riot police. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump Campaigns for Republican Ally in New York Governor's Race
item.description: Former President Donald Trump campaigned for Republican candidate Lee Zeldin in New York's gubernatorial race, aligning with Zeldin's political playbook. Trump's involvement has been noted in the context of the midterm elections, with one… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Stalin claims victory in Tamil Nadu bypoll, criticizes opponents
item.description: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin has described the results of a recent byelection as an "interim victory for betrayal" and the "downfall of fake images politics." He specifically targeted Vijay, indicating a political criticism… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Sonam Wangchuk's statement on politics and other concerns
item.description: Activist Sonam Wangchuk stated, 'There are more sorrows in the world than just politics.' When asked about coming to Jantar Mantar, he made this remark. The Lallantop reported this statement in Hindi. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: West Bengal to Abolish Madrasah Service Commission, Merge Functions
item.description: The West Bengal government is planning to abolish the Madrasah Service Commission and merge its functions with the West Bengal School Service Commission (WBSSC). This move aims to overhaul the state's madrasa teacher recruitment system… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Minister Pitches Hyderabad as Global Confidence Centre
item.description: Telangana Minister Sridhar Babu has proposed Hyderabad as a 'Global Confidence Centre'. This initiative aims to position the city as a hub for trust and reliability on a global scale. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kerala CM Satheesan Denies Election Irregularity Allegations
item.description: Kerala Chief Minister Satheesan has rejected allegations of irregularities concerning the SIR (State Investment Review) and claims that it influenced the UDF's victory in Keralam. He stated that Keralam's case is different, implying a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India says UN observer group irrelevant post-Simla Agreement
item.description: India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) stated that the United Nations Military Observer Group in India and Pakistan (UNMOGIP) has "outlived its relevance" following the Simla Agreement. This statement was made in response to the UN… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: PM Modi claims by-election wins show public support for BJP-NDA
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that the results of recent by-elections reflect public support for the governance agenda of the BJP-NDA coalition. He also praised party workers and voters for their role in securing these victories. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: CJP Leaders Accuse Centre of Imposing Emergency, Targeting Gen Z
item.description: Leaders of the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) have accused the central government of imposing an "undeclared emergency" and being afraid of the younger generation, referred to as "Gen Z." The accusations were made in the context of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump Appoints Katie Zacharia as White House Press Secretary
item.description: Donald Trump has appointed Katie Zacharia as the next White House press secretary, replacing Karoline Leavitt. Zacharia is described as a conservative commentator and currently works as a communications adviser at Trump Media & Technology… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 3.

item.title: Kamal Haasan Responds to Elon Musk's Tweets on India
item.description: Actor and politician Kamal Haasan responded to tweets by Elon Musk regarding India, stating that Indians will address their strengths and shortcomings internally, asserting that "India is a democracy, not a colony." This statement came… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: Trump agrees diesel deal with Putin, drawing criticism
item.description: Donald Trump announced an agreement with Vladimir Putin for Russia to supply "300,000 tons of diesel" to the US, with millions more to follow, in a bid to lower fuel prices. The deal reverses years of pressure on Russia over the Ukraine… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 6 · Right 2.

item.title: Elon Musk targets Ambani over Starlink, Rahul Gandhi links President Murmu to 'vote chori' claims
item.description: Elon Musk escalated a dispute over his Starlink satellite service in India by sarcastically addressing Mukesh Ambani as 'Prime Minister' and alleging monopolistic practices are blocking his service. This marks a sharp escalation in the… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 9 · Right 3.

item.title: Trump Honors Tech Leaders with National Medals of Science
item.description: President Donald Trump hosted a ceremony to award the National Medal of Science to six prominent tech leaders, including Satya Nadella and Elon Musk. The event garnered international attention. The Guardian reported the ceremony occurred… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: US Senator Vance calls Indians 'indentured laborers'; India responds
item.description: US Senator JD Vance referred to Indian H-1B visa holders as 'indentured laborers,' alleging that IT companies exploit the system by hiring foreign workers over Americans. India issued a sharp response, urging Vance not to forget America's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Noida's Jewar Airport Renamed After Prime Minister Narendra Modi
item.description: Uttar Pradesh's cabinet has approved the renaming of the upcoming Jewar airport near Noida to Narendra Modi International Airport. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced the decision following a cabinet meeting, stating the airport will… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 13 · Right 5.

item.title: Karnataka CM Alleges Sting Operation Plot; Ex-CM Accuses Rival
item.description: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar has alleged that a plot to trap him in a sting operation was initiated soon after he took office. He stated he possesses evidence identifying those behind this alleged attempt. These claims follow… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Gaurav Yadav Appointed Punjab's Regular Director General of Police
item.description: Gaurav Yadav has been appointed the regular Director General of Police (DGP) of Punjab and has assumed charge. Following his appointment, Yadav stated that there is no place for gangsters in Punjab. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Mayoral Candidates Debate Local Issues and Spending
item.description: Mayoral candidates in North Bay, Ontario, and Mississauga engaged in debates focusing on local issues, including the outgoing mayor's spending controversy in North Bay. The debates saw candidates clashing over various topics relevant to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Republicans Highlight Crime, Court Stakes Ahead of Midterms
item.description: Ahead of the midterm elections, Republicans are emphasizing a "tough-on-crime" message and raising alarms about the potential long-term impact on the Supreme Court. The coverage suggests these issues are seen as significant stakes in the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: US Probes Universities Over J-1 Visas Amid Student Rule Tightening
item.description: The U.S. is investigating nine universities concerning the J-1 exchange visitor visa program, as the Trump administration tightens student-related rules. Senator JD Vance alleged that universities were utilizing foreign researchers to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Malaysia's Melaka State Election Set for November 14 Amid Shifting Alliances
item.description: Melaka, a state in Malaysia, will hold its state election on November 14, with nominations opening on October 26. The election involves nearly 700,000 voters. This comes as the Barisan Nasional (BN) coalition, led by Umno, is reportedly… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: US Administration Actions on Peptides and Immigrant Children
item.description: The Trump administration is facilitating the temporary sale of certain unapproved peptides. Additionally, government lawyers will represent unaccompanied immigrant children. Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: India slams US Senator's 'indentured servants' remark on H-1B workers
item.description: India's Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) strongly condemned remarks made by US Senator JD Vance, describing them as 'deeply offensive' and 'unwarranted'. The MEA stated that Indian professionals significantly contribute to the US economy… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 9 · Right 4.

item.title: Naked Trump Statue Unveiled at EU Parliament
item.description: A nude gold statue depicting Donald Trump, referred to as 'Orange Plague,' has been unveiled at the European Parliament. The statue's display was reported by CNN and USA Today. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Michigan GOP Senate Candidate Defies Trump on Canada Tariffs
item.description: Michigan Republican Senate candidate John James has broken with former President Donald Trump's stance on tariffs, stating that "Canada is not our enemy." This marks a divergence from Trump's protectionist trade policies. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Nobel Laureate Demands Venezuelan Election Transparency Amid Oil Deal
item.description: Venezuelan Nobel Peace Prize laureate Maria Ressa has called for transparency regarding oil revenues, stating the country is 'ready' for new elections. This demand follows a reported deal involving former Trump administration officials… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Burnham meets German Chancellor Merz in Berlin for security talks
item.description: Mayor of Greater Manchester, Andy Burnham, met with German Chancellor Olaf Scholz in Berlin for security discussions. The meeting's agenda included topics relevant to security. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Donald Trump Not Awarded Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: Donald Trump was not awarded the Nobel Peace Prize, an award he has reportedly long coveted. He had previously stated that "nobody deserves it more" than him. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Carney: Canadians Will Decide Future After Musk's Separatism Remark
item.description: Mark Carney stated that Canadians will decide their future following Elon Musk's comments advocating for Quebec separatism. Carney's remarks emphasize that the decision rests with the Canadian people. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump Promotes New Child Investment Accounts
item.description: Former U.S. President Donald Trump is encouraging parents to claim "Trump Accounts," described as child investment accounts, with a reported value of $1,000. Auto-enrollment for these accounts has begun, and eligibility details are being… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: US reviews voter records for noncitizens, parallels drawn to India
item.description: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) has reviewed tens of millions of voter records to identify suspected noncitizen registrations. This action has been compared to India's Systematic Voter-Education and Electoral Registration… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump to Honor Elon Musk and Jensen Huang with US Science Medals
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump is set to award Elon Musk and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang with the nation's top science and technology medals. The announcement comes as Trump disclosed trades in Nvidia stock, the company led by Huang. Huang… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Chhattisgarh Transfers 18 IPS Officers
item.description: In Chhattisgarh, 18 Indian Police Service (IPS) officers have been transferred, with officials from the 2021 to 2024 batches assigned new responsibilities. Ishu Agarwal is among those named in the transfers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Vote Counting Underway for Bypolls in Tamil Nadu and Puducherry
item.description: Vote counting has commenced for by-elections held in Tamil Nadu and Puducherry. Specifically, counting is underway for the Dharapuram Assembly Constituency in Tamil Nadu and the Thatchanjavady Assembly Constituency in Puducherry. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: India Defends Satellite Policy After Elon Musk's 'Oligarch' Remark
item.description: The Indian government has stated that its policies and processes for satellite communication clearances are "non-discriminatory" and "fair." This statement comes after Elon Musk, founder of SpaceX, referred to the Indian government's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AINRC Wins Puducherry Bypoll, TVK Leads in Tamil Nadu
item.description: The All India N.R. Congress (AINRC) secured a significant victory in the Thattanchavady constituency bypoll in Puducherry, retaining the bastion of N. Rangasamy. In Tamil Nadu, the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) maintained its lead in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
